preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 100,000.
The number of cities n must be between 2 and 200,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= c_i <= 1000000 for c_i in c) and all(1 <= d_i <= 1000000 for d_i in d)
preconditions.description: All flag colors c_i and desired colors d_i must be between 1 and 1,000,000.
The length of the flag color list c and the desired color list d must both be equal to n.

preconditions.expression: len(roads) == n - 1 and all(1 <= x <= n and 1 <= y <= n for x, y in roads)
preconditions.description: The number of roads must be n-1, and each road must connect two valid cities.

postconditions.description: If a valid route exists, the output must start with 'Yes'.
If no valid route exists, the output must start with 'No'.
If the initial colors match the desired colors, the output must be 'Yes' followed by '0'.

postconditions.expression: k > 0 and len(route) == k and all(1 <= u_i <= n for u_i in route)
postconditions.description: If a valid route exists, the output must include the length k and the route of k cities.
